strings.biome.ember_mantle.description: 1050 to 1650 m, and hot. Lava pockets sit behind ordinary-looking stone, and heat becomes the limit long before fuel does.
strings.biome.ember_mantle.name: Ember Mantle
strings.biome.machine_strata.description: From 1650 to 2400 m the strata are half-built. Pistons still cycle, turrets still track, and none of it was left for you.
strings.biome.machine_strata.name: Machine Strata
strings.biome.mycelial_deeps.description: From 650 to 1050 m the rock is threaded with living mat. Spores and corrosive seep make this the first depth that punishes a slow return.
strings.biome.mycelial_deeps.name: Mycelial Deeps
strings.biome.prism_faults.description: A fractured crystal belt from 250 to 650 m. The faults hold prismite and a standing charge; both arrive without much warning.
strings.biome.prism_faults.name: Prism Faults
strings.biome.the_fracture.description: Below 2400 m the layers stop making sense. Everything down here is worth the trip, if the trip ends.
strings.biome.the_fracture.name: The Fracture
strings.biome.weathered_shelf.description: Loose surface strata down to 250 m. Soft rock, common metals, and just enough loose ceiling to teach you to look up.
strings.biome.weathered_shelf.name: Weathered Shelf
strings.contract.austere_run_deep.description: The same terms in the Ember Mantle. The Guild considers this a reasonable request.
strings.contract.austere_run_deep.name: Austere Run: Mantle
strings.contract.austere_run_shelf.description: Reach depth with no survival modules fitted. The Cooperative wants to know what the rig does unaided.
strings.contract.austere_run_shelf.name: Austere Run: Shelf
strings.contract.component_supply_cores.descript: Finished thermal cores for the Emberworks. High pay, and every one costs you a batch you could have used yourself.
strings.contract.component_supply_cores.name: Thermal Core Supply
strings.contract.component_supply_plates.descrip: Refined plate, not ore. You will be running the refinery to fill this one.
strings.contract.component_supply_plates.name: Plate Supply
strings.contract.deeps_probe.description: A sounding from the mycelial layer. Bring spore protection or bring a good excuse.
strings.contract.deeps_probe.name: Deeps Probe
strings.contract.faults_probe.description: Deepline wants a reading from inside the fault belt. Get to depth, hold, return.
strings.contract.faults_probe.name: Faults Probe
strings.contract.first_descent.description: Reach 150 m and come back up. The Cooperative logs it, and you learn what the fuel gauge means.
strings.contract.first_descent.name: First Descent
strings.contract.fracture_probe.description: Below 2700 m, on Deepline's account. The deepest sounding anyone has been paid to attempt.
strings.contract.fracture_probe.name: Fracture Probe
strings.contract.fracture_riftalloy_pact.descrip: Deepline's largest standing order, for a metal that should not exist. Signed, sealed and very well paid.
strings.contract.fracture_riftalloy_pact.name: Riftalloy Pact
strings.contract.guild_emberglass_order.descript: The Guild wants mantle glass with the heat still in it. Bring a cooled hold.
strings.contract.guild_emberglass_order.name: Emberglass Order
strings.contract.guild_gold_tithe.description: Aurelite, delivered to the Emberworks. Their terms are blunt and their payments clear the same day.
strings.contract.guild_gold_tithe.name: Gold Tithe
strings.contract.guild_mycelith_cultures.descrip: Live-cored mycelith, sealed. Deepline will not say what for, and pays enough that nobody asks twice.
strings.contract.guild_mycelith_cultures.name: Mycelith Cultures
strings.contract.locate_lost_deeps_crew.descript: The same call from the mycelial layer, two days later than anyone would like.
strings.contract.locate_lost_deeps_crew.name: Missing Deeps Crew
strings.contract.locate_lost_shelf_crew.descript: A Cooperative rig stopped reporting somewhere above 250 m. Reach the beacon.
strings.contract.locate_lost_shelf_crew.name: Missing Shelf Crew
strings.contract.mantle_probe.description: The Guild wants a temperature profile from inside their own back garden. Heat is the whole difficulty.
strings.contract.mantle_probe.name: Mantle Probe
strings.contract.mixed_metals_manifest.descripti: A crate of whatever comes out of the shelf, so long as it is metal and there is a lot of it.
strings.contract.mixed_metals_manifest.name: Mixed Metals Manifest
strings.contract.recover_faults_cache.descriptio: The same job, deeper, and with a standing charge in the rock around it.
strings.contract.recover_faults_cache.name: Faults Cache Recovery
strings.contract.recover_shelf_cache.description: A Cooperative cache went unclaimed. Find it, empty it, bring the crate back.
strings.contract.recover_shelf_cache.name: Shelf Cache Recovery
strings.contract.recover_strata_cache.descriptio: A cache in the machine levels. Whoever left it did not come back for it.
strings.contract.recover_strata_cache.name: Strata Cache Recovery
strings.contract.restore_transit_deep.descriptio: The same work at strata depth, on Guild money, on a node that has been dark a long time.
strings.contract.restore_transit_deep.name: Restore Deep Transit
strings.contract.restore_transit_faults.descript: Bring a transit node in the upper mine back online. You will use it more than they will.
strings.contract.restore_transit_faults.name: Restore Faults Transit
strings.contract.scan_fault_anomaly.description: Something in the faults is returning the wrong signal. Get a scanner close enough to say what.
strings.contract.scan_fault_anomaly.name: Fault Anomaly Scan
strings.contract.scan_forge_anomaly.description: Something in the foundry ruins is still drawing power. Deepline would like a number.
strings.contract.scan_forge_anomaly.name: Foundry Anomaly Scan
strings.contract.scan_hollow_anomaly.description: A reading from the mycelial hollows that Deepline cannot reproduce from the surface.
strings.contract.scan_hollow_anomaly.name: Hollow Anomaly Scan
strings.contract.shelf_copper_order.description: Cuprite by the crate, for wiring the yard nobody has finished rebuilding.
strings.contract.shelf_copper_order.name: Copper Order
strings.contract.shelf_ferrite_run.description: The Cooperative needs bulk iron and does not much mind where from. The job everyone starts with.
strings.contract.shelf_ferrite_run.name: Ferrite Run
strings.contract.stable_fulmenite.description: Fulmenite delivered intact, which means cutting it without discharging it. Volatile stability is the whole job.
strings.contract.stable_fulmenite.name: Stable Fulmenite
strings.contract.stable_voidcell.description: The hardest extraction on the board: voidcell, still charged, still whole. Bring containment or do not bring it at all.
strings.contract.stable_voidcell.name: Stable Voidcell
strings.contract.story_echo_recovery.description: Deepline want a single echo shard, brought up whole. They have been asking for one since before you arrived.
strings.contract.story_echo_recovery.name: The Echo
strings.contract.story_final_descent.description: 3600 m, with the Deepforge Protocol aboard. There is no delivery and no buyer - only the gate, and whether you reach it.
strings.contract.story_final_descent.name: The Final Descent
strings.contract.story_first_haul.description: Ten ferrite, delivered once. It is not the money - it is the yard confirming there is a working mine under it again.
strings.contract.story_first_haul.name: The First Haul
strings.contract.story_fracture_seed.description: A single fracture seed from the bottom of the world. Deepline will not say what happens next.
strings.contract.story_fracture_seed.name: The Seed
strings.contract.story_relic_recovery.descriptio: One relic core, intact, out of the machine strata. Everything the programme knows about the builders starts here.
strings.contract.story_relic_recovery.name: The Mechanism
strings.contract.strata_cogsteel_demand.descript: Machined fragments out of the strata. The Guild wants to know how they were made as much as they want the metal.
strings.contract.strata_cogsteel_demand.name: Cogsteel Demand
strings.contract.strata_probe.description: Reach the machine levels and survive them. What you record on the way is worth as much as the depth.
strings.contract.strata_probe.name: Strata Probe
strings.contract.survey_prismite_batch.descripti: Deepline wants faults-grade crystal for their optics bench, and pays in insight as well as credits.
strings.contract.survey_prismite_batch.name: Prismite Batch
strings.contract.survey_silver_consignment.descr: A standing order for argentine. Steady work at a depth you already run.
strings.contract.survey_silver_consignment.name: Silver Consignment
strings.cosmetic.decor_guild_banner.description: A banner for the hub wall. It does nothing. That is the point.
strings.cosmetic.decor_guild_banner.name: Guild Banner Kit
strings.cosmetic.livery_copperworks.description: Warm copper panels for a rig that likes to look like it works for a living.
strings.cosmetic.livery_copperworks.name: Copperworks Livery
strings.cosmetic.livery_deepsea.description: Cold blues for the rig that would rather be swimming than drilling.
strings.cosmetic.livery_deepsea.name: Deepsea Livery
strings.cosmetic.trail_emberwake.description: A spark trail that lingers a half-second longer than it should.
strings.cosmetic.trail_emberwake.name: Emberwake Trail
strings.equipment.cargo_bay.description: How much ore comes home. A full bay at 300 m beats an empty one at 900.
strings.equipment.cargo_bay.name: Cargo Bay
strings.equipment.cargo_bay.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.cargo_bay.tier4.summary: +88 cargo. Also and marks anything worth the detour automatically.
strings.equipment.cooling.description: Heat shed per second and total heat capacity. Below the mantle this is the limit long before fuel is.
strings.equipment.cooling.name: Cooling
strings.equipment.cooling.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.cooling.tier3.summary: 48% more cooling and +36 heat capacity. Also and survives one heat spike that would otherwise end the run.
strings.equipment.drill_efficiency.description: Fuel burned per tile cut. The quiet track: it never feels dramatic, and it decides how deep any given tank reaches.
strings.equipment.drill_efficiency.name: Drill Efficiency
strings.equipment.drill_efficiency.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.drill_efficiency.tier4.summary: 28% less fuel per tile. Also and reads which way a vein runs before you commit to it.
strings.equipment.drill_power.description: How hard the bit bites. Raising it cuts every tile faster and is the only way through the hardest rock at each depth.
strings.equipment.drill_power.name: Drill Power
strings.equipment.drill_power.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.drill_power.tier3.summary: +1.65 drill power. Also and lets the bit shatter brittle clusters in one pass.
strings.equipment.drill_power.tier6.summary: +3.30 drill power and a wider cut.
strings.equipment.engine.description: Thrust and braking. It is what carries a loaded hold back up the shaft, which is the half of the run that goes wrong.
strings.equipment.engine.name: Engine
strings.equipment.engine.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.engine.tier2.summary: 22% more thrust and 18% stronger braking. Also and brakes without spending fuel.
strings.equipment.engine.tier7.summary: 77% more thrust and 63% stronger braking. Also and holds a hover on its own.
strings.equipment.fuel_tank.description: Total fuel carried. Every metre down is a metre you have to pay for again on the way back.
strings.equipment.fuel_tank.name: Fuel Tank
strings.equipment.fuel_tank.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.hull.description: Damage the rig absorbs before the run ends. Also the difference between a hard landing and a tow.
strings.equipment.hull.name: Hull
strings.equipment.hull.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.hull.tier5.summary: +130 hull and 25% less impact damage. Also and frees the rig from a bad wedge at no cost.
strings.equipment.power_core.description: The module power budget. Every module costs power, and this track is the only thing that raises what you have to spend.
strings.equipment.power_core.name: Power Core
strings.equipment.power_core.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.power_core.tier3.summary: +3 module power and +1 protected sample slot.
strings.equipment.power_core.tier6.summary: +7 module power and +1 protected sample slot.
strings.equipment.scanner.description: Range and detail of what you can see through rock. Cutting blind is expensive; this is how you stop.
strings.equipment.scanner.name: Scanner
strings.equipment.scanner.tier0.summary: What the rig came with. Serviceable at the surface and nowhere else.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier1.summary: +4 m scanner range and sharper readout.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier2.summary: +8 m scanner range, sharper readout and more of each vein revealed.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier3.summary: +12 m scanner range and sharper readout.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier4.summary: +16 m scanner range and sharper readout.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier5.summary: +20 m scanner range and sharper readout.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier6.summary: +24 m scanner range and sharper readout. Also and scans clean through solid rock.
strings.equipment.scanner.tier7.summary: +28 m scanner range and sharper readout.
strings.facility.contract_terminal.description: A better line to the buyers. Each tier raises every contract payout, on work you were doing anyway.
strings.facility.contract_terminal.name: Contract Terminal
strings.facility.garage.description: Better tooling on the yard floor. Each tier cuts what repairs cost you, which is most of what a bad run costs.
strings.facility.garage.name: Garage
strings.facility.logistics_lift.description: Cheaper fuel at the pad, and at the top tier a working transit link to the nodes you have found below.
strings.facility.logistics_lift.name: Logistics Lift
strings.facility.recovery_bay.description: Cheaper extractions and more cargo recovered from them. The upgrade you buy so the deep runs are worth attempting.
strings.facility.recovery_bay.name: Recovery Bay
strings.facility.refinery.description: Turns raw ore into components. Each tier raises yield and opens the recipes the last equipment tiers depend on.
strings.facility.refinery.name: Refinery
strings.facility.research_lab.description: More insight from every sample, and more protected slots to bring samples home in.
strings.facility.research_lab.name: Research Lab
strings.faction.deepline_survey.description: Cartographers by trade and completists by temperament. They pay for knowing where things are.
strings.faction.deepline_survey.name: Deepline Survey
strings.faction.emberworks_guild.description: Heat specialists out of the mantle works. Difficult to impress, and the only source of the deepest cooling kit.
strings.faction.emberworks_guild.name: Emberworks Guild
strings.faction.shelf_cooperative.description: The surface operators' association. Practical, unglamorous, and the first people to trust you with anything.
strings.faction.shelf_cooperative.name: Shelf Cooperative
strings.hazard.corrosive_seep.description: Acidic groundwater running along a fault. It does little at once and a great deal if you park in it.
strings.hazard.corrosive_seep.name: Corrosive Seep
strings.hazard.crushing_piston.description: Still on its cycle after all this time. The heaviest single hit in the mine, and it announces every stroke.
strings.hazard.crushing_piston.name: Crushing Piston
strings.hazard.electric_arc.description: Charge jumping between crystal faces. A magnetic stabiliser gives the current somewhere better to go.
strings.hazard.electric_arc.name: Electric Arc
strings.hazard.gas_vent.description: Pressurised gas escaping along a joint. It hisses for a moment before it ignites, which is the whole of your warning.
strings.hazard.gas_vent.name: Gas Vent
strings.hazard.lava_pocket.description: A sealed melt cavity that vents when the seal is cut. Heavy contact damage and a fast heat spike; lava shielding is the answer.
strings.hazard.lava_pocket.name: Lava Pocket
strings.hazard.magnetic_field.description: A wide standing field that drags on the hull and scrambles the scanner. Stabilisers cancel it.
strings.hazard.magnetic_field.name: Magnetic Field
strings.hazard.sentry_turret.description: An automated emplacement that never received a stand-down order. It tracks at five metres and fires past that.
strings.hazard.sentry_turret.name: Sentry Turret
strings.hazard.shard_burst.description: Stored strain in a crystal seam releasing all at once. Quick to arrive, wide enough to catch a careless hover.
strings.hazard.shard_burst.name: Shard Burst
strings.hazard.spore_cloud.description: A wide release of live spore that etches seals and coats intakes. Spore immunity stops it outright.
strings.hazard.spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
strings.hazard.unstable_ceiling.description: Rock that has lost its support and knows it. Dust falls first; the ceiling follows about a second later.
strings.hazard.unstable_ceiling.name: Unstable Ceiling
strings.landmark.artifact_chamber.description: A deliberate space, sealed and centred on a single object. Exactly one artifact, every time.
strings.landmark.artifact_chamber.name: Artifact Chamber
strings.landmark.challenge_shaft.description: A deep vertical run with real ore at the bottom and no comfortable way out. Rare, and paid accordingly.
strings.landmark.challenge_shaft.name: Challenge Shaft
strings.landmark.collapsed_survey_post.descripti: An abandoned shelf outpost. The ore left in it is ordinary; the fact that it was abandoned is not.
strings.landmark.collapsed_survey_post.name: Collapsed Survey Post
strings.landmark.cooling_pocket.description: A pocket of cold trapped in the mantle. Somewhere to shed heat before the next push down.
strings.landmark.cooling_pocket.name: Cooling Pocket
strings.landmark.crumbly_seam.description: A wide band of rock with nothing holding it. Fast to cut through, and it does not stay where you put it.
strings.landmark.crumbly_seam.name: Crumbly Seam
strings.landmark.foundry_ruin.description: A machine hall that stopped mid-shift. Cogsteel and platinex, under things that still move.
strings.landmark.foundry_ruin.name: Foundry Ruin
strings.landmark.fracture_gate.description: One per world, at the very bottom. Whatever the Deepforge programme was named after, this is it.
strings.landmark.fracture_gate.name: Fracture Gate
strings.landmark.mycelial_hollow.description: A chamber grown rather than cut, walls thick with mycelith. It reacts to the drill.
strings.landmark.mycelial_hollow.name: Mycelial Hollow
strings.landmark.open_cavern.description: A natural void in the shelf. Free travel, no cover, and a long drop if you misjudge the far wall.
strings.landmark.open_cavern.name: Open Cavern
strings.landmark.prism_geode.description: A crystal-lined cavity in the fault belt, and the most reliable prismite in the mine.
strings.landmark.prism_geode.name: Prism Geode
strings.landmark.repair_station.description: A working service point below the surface. Hull back, without the climb.
strings.landmark.repair_station.name: Repair Station
strings.landmark.rescue_beacon.description: Still transmitting. Reaching one takes the fee off your next extraction.
strings.landmark.rescue_beacon.name: Rescue Beacon
strings.landmark.supply_cache.description: Someone else's stashed ore, left where they meant to come back for it. Common at every depth.
strings.landmark.supply_cache.name: Supply Cache
strings.landmark.thermal_vent.description: A column of rising heat. Fast to cross, dangerous to linger in, and a clean route up for anything that can take the temperature.
strings.landmark.thermal_vent.name: Thermal Vent
strings.landmark.transit_node.description: Part of an old lift network. With transit access it becomes a way down that costs no fuel at all.
strings.landmark.transit_node.name: Transit Node
strings.material.air.description: Nothing to cut. Watch your fall.
strings.material.air.name: Open Air
strings.material.argentine.description: A silver-bearing ore that shows as pale flecks in darker rock. Steady money for a steady run.
strings.material.argentine.name: Argentine
strings.material.aurelite.description: Gold locked in a brittle host. Worth four holds of ferrite, and it sits deep enough that the fuel is a real question.
strings.material.aurelite.name: Aurelite
strings.material.basalt.description: Cooled flow rock, dense and even. The first stone that makes a stock drill work for its fuel.
strings.material.basalt.name: Basalt
strings.material.bedrock.description: The floor of the world. No drill made will touch it.
strings.material.bedrock.name: Bedrock
strings.material.circuit_lattice.description: Printed conductive matrix. Scanners and power cores are mostly this, by volume.
strings.material.circuit_lattice.name: Circuit Lattice
strings.material.cogsteel.description: Machined alloy recovered in fragments, all of them cut to tolerances nobody down here can reproduce.
strings.material.cogsteel.name: Cogsteel
strings.material.cuprite.description: Red copper ore in bright ribbons. The first material worth changing course for.
strings.material.cuprite.name: Cuprite
strings.material.drive_cell.description: The refinery's best work: stored power dense enough for the last tiers of every track.
strings.material.drive_cell.name: Drive Cell
strings.material.echo_shard.description: It repeats sounds made near it, minutes late and slightly wrong. Sample storage only - no buyer, and no shortage of researchers.
strings.material.echo_shard.name: Echo Shard
strings.material.emberglass.description: Volcanic glass with heat still trapped in the lattice. Handle it in a cooled hold or don't handle it.
strings.material.emberglass.name: Emberglass
strings.material.ferrite.description: Common iron ore. It will not make you rich, but a full hold of it pays for the fuel that fetched it.
strings.material.ferrite.name: Ferrite
strings.material.fracture_seed.description: Recovered only at the very bottom. Whatever it is the beginning of, it has not finished.
strings.material.fracture_seed.name: Fracture Seed
strings.material.fulmenite.description: Holds a charge and resents being cut. A clean extraction is worth a great deal; a careless one is worth a tow.
strings.material.fulmenite.name: Fulmenite
strings.material.granite_spur.description: A structural mass, not a seam. Nothing you can carry is going to get through it - go around.
strings.material.granite_spur.name: Granite Spur
strings.material.loam.description: Packed topsoil and gravel. It parts almost politely, which is why every rig learns its trade in the first hundred metres.
strings.material.loam.name: Loam
strings.material.mycelith.description: Mineralised fungal cord, still faintly warm. It resists heat far better than anything grown has any right to.
strings.material.mycelith.name: Mycelith
strings.material.myco_chalk.description: Soft carbonate threaded through with old fungal mat. It powders under the bit and coats everything downwind.
strings.material.myco_chalk.name: Myco-Chalk
strings.material.platinex.description: Dense platinum-group ore. A handful pays for a tier; a full bay pays for the rig.
strings.material.platinex.name: Platinex
strings.material.prismite.description: Faceted crystal that throws the lamp back in colours. Refineries want it for optics; the market pays accordingly.
strings.material.prismite.name: Prismite
strings.material.refined_plate.description: Rolled hull stock from the refinery. The base component of every heavy upgrade.
strings.material.refined_plate.name: Refined Plate
strings.material.relic_core.description: The intact heart of a machine that stopped mid-task. Still warm at the centre.
strings.material.relic_core.name: Relic Core
strings.material.riftalloy.description: A metal that should not be stable at this pressure. It is, and every refinery on the surface would like to know why.
strings.material.riftalloy.name: Riftalloy
strings.material.shale.description: Layered mudstone that splits along its bedding. Cheap to cut, but it hides pockets that were never surveyed.
strings.material.shale.name: Shale
strings.material.slagcrete.description: Not natural. Someone poured this, in volume, a very long time ago, and it has outlasted whatever it was poured around.
strings.material.slagcrete.name: Slagcrete
strings.material.spore_codex.description: A dense fungal body with a repeating internal structure. The research team insists that is not the same as writing.
strings.material.spore_codex.name: Spore Codex
strings.material.starmetal.description: An iron-nickel mass that fell from somewhere else and has been buried ever since. The most valuable thing you can simply dig up.
strings.material.starmetal.name: Starmetal
strings.material.thermal_core.description: A sealed heat exchanger. Everything that keeps a deep rig from cooking has one inside it.
strings.material.thermal_core.name: Thermal Core
strings.material.voidcell.description: A pocket of stored energy in mineral form. The most dangerous payload you can legally carry, and the best paid.
strings.material.voidcell.name: Voidcell
strings.material.voidshale.description: Black laminate that drinks the headlamp. It cuts hard and it cuts quiet.
strings.material.voidshale.name: Voidshale
strings.module.afterburner.description: Forty per cent more thrust. Buys back the climb that a full hold takes away.
strings.module.afterburner.name: Afterburner
strings.module.assay_uplink.description: Sells against live surface prices: twelve per cent on ore and ten per cent on contracts, for one unit of power.
strings.module.assay_uplink.name: Assay Uplink
strings.module.auto_collector.description: Draws loose ore in from four and a half metres. You stop reversing over your own spoil.
strings.module.auto_collector.name: Auto-Collector
strings.module.ballast_trim.description: Redistributes the load so a full hold weighs a quarter less on the way up.
strings.module.ballast_trim.name: Ballast Trim
strings.module.bio_regenerator.description: Cultured mycelith patches the hull as you work: twelve per cent more hull and a quarter off repair bills.
strings.module.bio_regenerator.name: Bio-Regenerator
strings.module.cargo_compactor.description: Twenty-eight more units of hold. The difference between turning back and finishing the seam.
strings.module.cargo_compactor.name: Cargo Compactor
strings.module.containment_field.description: Holds volatile cargo genuinely stable and cuts hazard damage by thirty per cent. Four power - you build the whole loadout around it.
strings.module.containment_field.name: Containment Field
strings.module.cryo_manifold.description: Seventy per cent more cooling and forty more heat capacity. The deepest heat solution there is, and it costs three power to run.
strings.module.cryo_manifold.name: Cryo Manifold
strings.module.deployable_beacon.description: Drop a marker you can navigate back to, and recover a fifth more from a wreck site.
strings.module.deployable_beacon.name: Deployable Beacon
strings.module.directional_scanner.description: Six more metres of range, and veins report which way they run rather than merely that they exist.
strings.module.directional_scanner.name: Directional Scanner
strings.module.emergency_seal.description: Thirty more hull and a thirty per cent cheaper extraction. One unit of power against the worst outcome.
strings.module.emergency_seal.name: Emergency Seal
strings.module.field_stabiliser.description: Cancels standing magnetic fields and takes fifteen per cent off hazard damage generally. Required kit in the Machine Strata.
strings.module.field_stabiliser.name: Field Stabiliser
strings.module.focused_cutter.description: Narrows the cutting face to a single point. Thirty per cent more drill power for one unit of power - the best value in the catalogue, and the first thing most rigs fit.
strings.module.focused_cutter.name: Focused Cutter
strings.module.grappling_anchor.description: Anchors to a wall and hauls, at ten per cent less hover fuel. Turns a vertical shaft into something you can rest in.
strings.module.grappling_anchor.name: Grappling Anchor
strings.module.harmonic_bit.description: Matches the bit to the rock it is in. Twenty-two per cent more power on fifteen per cent less fuel.
strings.module.harmonic_bit.name: Harmonic Bit
strings.module.hazard_imager.description: Shows hazards before they telegraph, which is worth about eighteen per cent of the damage they would have done.
strings.module.hazard_imager.name: Hazard Imager
strings.module.heat_sink.description: Forty per cent more cooling. The plain answer to the Ember Mantle.
strings.module.heat_sink.name: Heat Sink
strings.module.insulated_plating.description: Forty per cent less hazard damage and a quarter less heat from depth. Heavy on power, and worth it below 1500 m.
strings.module.insulated_plating.name: Insulated Plating
strings.module.kinetic_buffer.description: Halves impact damage, near enough. Falls and collapses stop being run-ending events.
strings.module.kinetic_buffer.name: Kinetic Buffer
strings.module.landmark_triangulator.description: Ten more metres of range and twelve per cent better contract pay, because you can prove where you were.
strings.module.landmark_triangulator.name: Landmark Triangulator
strings.module.low_fuel_hover.description: Holds altitude on a trickle: twenty-eight per cent less hover fuel, and station-keeping while you cut sideways.
strings.module.low_fuel_hover.name: Hover Assist
strings.module.material_filter.description: Names what the scanner finds and marks anything worth the detour. One power, and the map stops being guesswork.
strings.module.material_filter.name: Material Filter
strings.module.portable_refinery.description: Refines in the hold, at ten per cent better yield than the yard. Three power, and a deep run pays out as components.
strings.module.portable_refinery.name: Portable Refinery
strings.module.precision_extractor.description: A slower, cleaner cut: thirty-five per cent more yield and far steadier handling of volatile ore.
strings.module.precision_extractor.name: Precision Extractor
strings.module.pulse_drill.description: Hammers rather than grinds. Seventy-five per cent more drill power for forty per cent more heat - superb above the mantle, a liability inside it.
strings.module.pulse_drill.name: Pulse Drill
strings.module.resonance_array.description: Scans straight through rock at twelve extra metres, and returns a fifth more insight from everything it reads.
strings.module.resonance_array.name: Resonance Array
strings.module.rift_lens.description: Reads structure the other instruments cannot resolve. Full scanner detail and a third more insight - the researcher's module.
strings.module.rift_lens.name: Rift Lens
strings.module.spore_filter.description: Seals the intakes. Spore clouds stop mattering entirely, for one unit of power.
strings.module.spore_filter.name: Spore Filter
strings.module.stabiliser_gyros.description: Forty-five per cent stronger braking and a fifth less impact damage. One unit of power to stop falling badly.
strings.module.stabiliser_gyros.name: Stabiliser Gyros
strings.module.thermal_reclaimer.description: Bleeds waste heat back into the fuel loop. Cuts heat and buys depth at the same time.
strings.module.thermal_reclaimer.name: Thermal Reclaimer
strings.module.wide_fracture_head.description: Cuts a tile wider than the rig and takes ten per cent more out of it. Three power, and shafts stop being tight.
strings.module.wide_fracture_head.name: Wide Fracture Head
strings.recipe.circuit_lattice.description: Prismite and cuprite printed into a conductive matrix, with a little ferrite recovered from the run.
strings.recipe.circuit_lattice.name: Circuit Lattice
strings.recipe.drive_cell.description: Cogsteel, lattice and gold, at considerable expense. The component the last tier of every track asks for.
strings.recipe.drive_cell.name: Drive Cell
strings.recipe.emberglass_ingot.description: Six emberglass down to two plates. Inefficient by value, and the fastest plate you can make once the mantle is open.
strings.recipe.emberglass_ingot.name: Emberglass Ingot
strings.recipe.lattice_press.description: Riftalloy pressed against lattice yields a drive cell and returns a lattice. The best conversion in the yard, if you can reach the riftalloy.
strings.recipe.lattice_press.name: Lattice Press
strings.recipe.refined_plate.description: Eight ferrite and three cuprite, rolled into one plate. The starting recipe, and the one you will run most.
strings.recipe.refined_plate.name: Refined Plate
strings.recipe.thermal_core.description: Emberglass and mycelith sealed around a plate. Everything that survives the mantle contains one.
strings.recipe.thermal_core.name: Thermal Core
strings.research.alloy_forging.description: Emberglass and cogsteel, worked hot. Drive cells, insulated plating, and clearance for the Machine Strata.
strings.research.alloy_forging.name: Alloy Forging
strings.research.ancient_mechanisms.description: A relic core, opened carefully. Enough of it is legible to grant transit access and to build the anchor and the triangulator.
strings.research.ancient_mechanisms.name: Ancient Mechanisms
strings.research.crystal_optics.description: An echo shard, cut and mounted, turns out to make an excellent lens. Opens directional scanning, material filtering and the circuit lattice.
strings.research.crystal_optics.name: Crystal Optics
strings.research.deep_cooling.description: Fifteen per cent better cooling across the board, and the cryo manifold. The gate on sustained work below the mantle.
strings.research.deep_cooling.name: Deep Cooling
strings.research.deep_survey.description: Formal mapping past the fault belt. Three metres of scanner range, hazard imaging, and clearance for the Mycelial Deeps.
strings.research.deep_survey.name: Deep Survey
strings.research.deepforge_protocol.description: Everything the programme has learned, applied at once: a fifth more drill power, fifteen per cent more hull, and lava shielding as standard. The last thing on the board.
strings.research.deepforge_protocol.name: Deepforge Protocol
strings.research.expedition_logistics.descriptio: Everything about staying down longer: beacons, the portable refinery and low-fuel hover.
strings.research.expedition_logistics.name: Expedition Logistics
strings.research.field_metallurgy.description: Grading ore at the face instead of at the yard. Unlocks the focused cutter and the plate recipe that every heavy upgrade is eventually built from.
strings.research.field_metallurgy.name: Field Metallurgy
strings.research.fracture_containment.descriptio: Holding a fracture-grade sample without it holding you. Fifteen per cent off all hazard damage and the containment field.
strings.research.fracture_containment.name: Fracture Containment
strings.research.lattice_engineering.description: Printing structure instead of casting it. Cargo compaction, auto-collection and the lattice press.
strings.research.lattice_engineering.name: Lattice Engineering
strings.research.magnetic_damping.description: Standing fields in the strata can be cancelled rather than endured. Required before the deeper machine levels are survivable.
strings.research.magnetic_damping.name: Magnetic Damping
strings.research.pulse_drilling.description: Percussive cutting at controlled frequency. The pulse drill and the wide fracture head both come out of it.
strings.research.pulse_drilling.name: Pulse Drilling
strings.research.resonance_mapping.description: Scanning through solid rock, at last. The array reads a seam before you commit a metre of fuel to reaching it.
strings.research.resonance_mapping.name: Resonance Mapping
strings.research.rift_analysis.description: A fracture seed, held still long enough to read. Opens the rift lens and clearance for The Fracture itself.
strings.research.rift_analysis.name: Rift Analysis
strings.research.salvage_protocols.description: A quarter more recovered from a wreck site and a fifth off every extraction fee. The research that makes failure affordable.
strings.research.salvage_protocols.name: Salvage Protocols
strings.research.symbiotic_shielding.description: The spore codex is not hostile - it is territorial, and it can be persuaded. Grants outright spore immunity and the biological hull modules.
strings.research.symbiotic_shielding.name: Symbiotic Shielding
strings.research.thermal_recovery.description: Waste heat as a resource rather than a problem. Heat sinks, the reclaimer, thermal cores, and clearance for the Ember Mantle.
strings.research.thermal_recovery.name: Thermal Recovery
strings.research.volatile_handling.description: Procedure for cutting charged ore without discharging it. Volatile cargo becomes markedly more stable, and precision extraction becomes possible.
strings.research.volatile_handling.name: Volatile Handling
strings.skill.assayer.description: You grade your own haul before the buyer does, and it shows in the price.
strings.skill.assayer.name: Assayer
strings.skill.ballast_master.description: A loaded hold weighs eighteen per cent less. A full bay stops meaning a slow climb.
strings.skill.ballast_master.name: Ballast Master
strings.skill.clean_extraction.description: Twelve per cent more yield, and volatile ore sits noticeably calmer in the hold.
strings.skill.clean_extraction.name: Clean Extraction
strings.skill.coolant_routing.description: Twelve per cent better cooling from the same loop, simply by running it somewhere sensible.
strings.skill.coolant_routing.name: Coolant Routing
strings.skill.curator.description: A fifth more insight from every sample, and one more protected slot to bring one home in.
strings.skill.curator.name: Curator
strings.skill.deep_acclimation.description: Fifteen per cent less ambient heat from depth alone, before any hazard is involved.
strings.skill.deep_acclimation.name: Deep Acclimation
strings.skill.deep_pockets.description: Twelve more units of hold. One more good seam before the climb.
strings.skill.deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
strings.skill.emergency_protocols.description: Extraction costs a quarter less and returns a fifth of the cargo you would otherwise lose. Insurance, not a plan.
strings.skill.emergency_protocols.name: Emergency Protocols
strings.skill.engineer_mastery.description: Fifteen per cent more drill power for ten per cent less fuel. The single best cutting upgrade in the tree.
strings.skill.engineer_mastery.name: Engineer Mastery
strings.skill.field_repairs.description: You patch what you can before docking, and the yard charges fifteen per cent less for the rest.
strings.skill.field_repairs.name: Field Repairs
strings.skill.fuel_chemistry.description: Refuelling costs eighteen per cent less and burns six per cent leaner. The cheapest depth you will ever buy.
strings.skill.fuel_chemistry.name: Fuel Chemistry
strings.skill.hardened_frame.description: Twenty-four more hull and twelve per cent less impact damage. A hard landing stops ending the run.
strings.skill.hardened_frame.name: Hardened Frame
strings.skill.hazard_sense.description: Fifteen per cent less hazard damage. You still trigger them; they just take less of you.
strings.skill.hazard_sense.name: Hazard Sense
strings.skill.heat_exchange.description: Twelve per cent less heat generated at the bit. The mantle stops being a timer.
strings.skill.heat_exchange.name: Heat Exchange
strings.skill.keen_eye.description: Two more metres of scanner reach. It sounds small until you stop cutting blind into every second seam.
strings.skill.keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
strings.skill.keystone_deep_diver.description: Depth heat drops by forty per cent and hazard damage by a quarter, for eight per cent less thrust. Built for the bottom, slow on the way back.
strings.skill.keystone_deep_diver.name: Deep Diver
strings.skill.keystone_highgrader.description: A quarter more sale value and fifteen per cent more yield, at the cost of four metres of scanner range. You take the best of what you can see, and you see less.
strings.skill.keystone_highgrader.name: Highgrader
strings.skill.keystone_lodefinder.description: Fourteen metres of extra scanner reach and full vein readout, paid for with six per cent of your yield. You will find everything and carry slightly less of it.
strings.skill.keystone_lodefinder.name: Lodefinder
strings.skill.keystone_overclock.description: Thirty-five per cent more drill power for thirty per cent more heat and slightly worse cooling. Cuts anything, briefly.
strings.skill.keystone_overclock.name: Overclock
strings.skill.keystone_sprinter.description: Forty per cent more thrust and a quarter less hover fuel, for twenty-five hull. Fast, and thin.
strings.skill.keystone_sprinter.name: Sprinter
strings.skill.keystone_thermal_symbiosis.descrip: Waste heat feeds back into the fuel loop, with a fifth better cooling and five per cent less drill power. The deep runs get much longer.
strings.skill.keystone_thermal_symbiosis.name: Thermal Symbiosis
strings.skill.light_touch.description: Eight per cent less fuel while hovering. Most of a run is hovering.
strings.skill.light_touch.name: Light Touch
strings.skill.long_haul.description: Forty-five more fuel. That is another two hundred metres of depth, or the margin to get back from them.
strings.skill.long_haul.name: Long Haul
strings.skill.market_sense.description: You know which day the refinery is short. Ten per cent on every sale.
strings.skill.market_sense.name: Market Sense
strings.skill.negotiator.description: Contract payouts rise fifteen per cent. The board has always had room to move; now you use it.
strings.skill.negotiator.name: Negotiator
strings.skill.pathfinder_mastery.description: Fifteen per cent more thrust, and the rig holds a controlled descent without touching the throttle.
strings.skill.pathfinder_mastery.name: Pathfinder Mastery
strings.skill.power_budgeting.description: Eight per cent more drill power and eight per cent more cooling, from the same core, by not asking for both at once.
strings.skill.power_budgeting.name: Power Budgeting
strings.skill.prospector_mastery.description: A fifth more ore from every tile, and the scanner starts naming what it finds instead of just marking it.
strings.skill.prospector_mastery.name: Prospector Mastery
strings.skill.refining_theory.description: Eighteen per cent more output from every refinery batch, which is where the last tiers of every track actually come from.
strings.skill.refining_theory.name: Refining Theory
strings.skill.rich_seams.description: Eight per cent more ore out of the same tile. The bit wastes less of what it breaks.
strings.skill.rich_seams.name: Rich Seams
strings.skill.shaft_runner.description: Twelve per cent more thrust and twelve per cent stronger braking. The shaft becomes a road.
strings.skill.shaft_runner.name: Shaft Runner
strings.skill.sure_footing.description: Ten per cent less damage from impacts. Landing badly becomes survivable.
strings.skill.sure_footing.name: Sure Footing
strings.skill.thrust_control.description: Eight per cent more lift. The climb out is the part of the run that kills people.
strings.skill.thrust_control.name: Thrust Control
strings.skill.tinkerer.description: Five per cent less fuel per tile cut. It compounds over a thousand tiles.
strings.skill.tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
strings.skill.torque_tuning.description: Twelve per cent more drill power. Hard rock stops being a wall and starts being a delay.
strings.skill.torque_tuning.name: Torque Tuning
strings.skill.vein_reader.description: Scanned veins reveal a quarter more of their extent, so you can tell a pocket from a run before committing fuel to it.
strings.skill.vein_reader.name: Vein Reader
strings.store.copperworks_livery.description: A paint job. The drill does not care what colour it is.
strings.store.copperworks_livery.name: Copperworks Livery
strings.store.deepsea_livery.description: A paint job. No stats, no shortcut, nothing the simulation can see.
strings.store.deepsea_livery.name: Deepsea Livery
strings.store.emberwake_trail.description: A particle trail for the garage screen and the open shaft.
strings.store.emberwake_trail.name: Emberwake Trail
strings.store.guild_banner.description: Hub decor. Purely for show, permanently yours.
strings.store.guild_banner.name: Guild Banner Kit
